newsitem.title: SPAIN: LME not looking at copper backwardation - King.
newsitem.headline: LME not looking at copper backwardation - King.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) has not reviewed the position regarding the current restriction on the daily backwardation in its copper market, LME Chief Executive David King said.
"There are no plans to change the backwardation limit - it has not been debated recently," King said at Metal Bulletin's 10th International Copper Conference.
Cash/one day, where the daily restriction applies, is currently under $1. The limit is around $25 today.
